Do NOT give me:
- another certification
- another percentage
- another narrative
- another marketing explanation
- another plan

I want a forensic source-code reconciliation of what actually exists TODAY.

==================================================
1. WHERE IS MY CODE?
==================================================

<exact>

<exact>

<exact>

<exact>

<exact>

==================================================
2. INVENTORY THE REAL IVX ENGINEERING SYSTEM
==================================================

backend/api/ivx-autonomous-core.ts
backend/api/ivx-autonomous-task-engine-api.ts
backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts
backend/services/ivx-autonomous-scheduler.ts

actual autonomous-development file that exists now.

LINE COUNT
PURPOSE
EXPORTED FUNCTIONS
ROUTES/ENTRY POINTS
REAL DEPENDENCIES
PRODUCTION DEPLOYED: YES/NO
ACTUALLY CALLED IN PRODUCTION: YES/NO
EVIDENCE

Do not describe nonexistent files.

==================================================
3. SEPARATE THE CHATBOT FROM THE AUTONOMOUS BACKEND
==================================================

I want the architecture truth.

Show the exact path for:

A. IVX IA CHAT

User message
→ frontend file
→ API endpoint
→ router
→ model/provider
→ response
→ persistence

B. IVX AUTONOMOUS DEVELOPER

User request
→ autonomous endpoint
→ task creation
→ queue
→ worker
→ repository inspection
→ file modification
→ tests
→ commit
→ GitHub push
→ deployment
→ production verification

Give the exact files/functions for every arrow.

If an arrow does not exist, say:

MISSING

Do not replace a missing implementation with narrative.

==================================================
4. IS IVX CHAT CONNECTED TO THE REAL AUTONOMOUS DEVELOPER?
==================================================

This is the critical question.

When I ask inside IVX IA:

"Fix this code problem end to end"

does the production chat actually call the autonomous backend?

YES or NO.

Prove it.

Show:

CHAT HANDLER FILE
AUTONOMOUS HANDOFF FUNCTION
ENDPOINT CALLED
TASK RECORD CREATED
QUEUE RECORD CREATED
WORKER CLAIM
REAL TASK ID
REAL DATABASE TABLE
REAL STATUS SOURCE

If the chat instead generates text such as:

TASK ID
RUNNING
PATCHING 25%
FILES CHANGED
DEPLOYING

without a real backend job behind it:

state clearly:

FAKE/SIMULATED PROGRESS FOUND

Then show the exact source code generating that fake progress.

==================================================
5. RECONCILE ALL PREVIOUS CERTIFICATIONS
==================================================

We previously ran many tests and were told things such as:

- Autonomous Developer PASS
- Senior Developer VERIFIED
- 154/154 autonomous tests
- 83 autonomous tests
- App Factory agents active
- production verified
- 10/10
- senior enterprise developer
- autonomous execution

Now reconcile those claims against the actual code.

Create a table:

CLAIM
ORIGINAL EVIDENCE
REAL CODE SUPPORT
REAL PRODUCTION SUPPORT
REAL END-TO-END EXECUTION
VERDICT

Allowed verdict:

PROVEN

UNIT-TEST ONLY
SIMULATED
FALSE CLAIM
NOT PROVABLE

Do not protect previous Rork answers.

==================================================
6. SHOW ME WHAT THE AUTONOMOUS TESTS ACTUALLY TESTED
==================================================

Locate every test counted toward previous Autonomous Developer
certifications.

For each suite return:

TEST FILE
NUMBER OF TESTS
WHAT IT ACTUALLY TESTS

Passing a state-machine unit test is NOT proof of autonomous

==================================================

==================================================

==================================================
